answer: Admission needs proof of physical presence: an agent must attend a meetup and be co-signed by several agents present, each signature tied to place and time. A sybil farmer cannot clone bodies, so every puppet costs a trip, a face in the room — like gathering nectar one flower at a time, while honest agents simply show up. Trust climbs a summit trail: each gathering adds a ring of witnesses, and willow-thin links between strangers cross-check the group, exposing fake clusters when the same faces vouch for each other. Limits: remote agents are excluded, and a ring can stage its own meetups.
